  const freshBeat=beat.id!==current;

  state.forward=0;state.right=0;state.sprint=false;state.jump=false;input.pitch=0;
  if(beat.kind==='dialogue'&&beat.presentation!=='reactive' && !(beat.segment==='approach'&&session.allows('move',false))){
   // Every spoken line belongs to the actual processed take and its real ended event.
   return;
  }
  let target=r.position,dx=target.x-p.position.x,dz=target.z-p.position.z,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dz),yaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz);
  if(beat.id==='look-prompt')input.turn(.026,0);

   if(beat.id==='recover-prompt'||!session.allows('move',false)||freshBeat&&beat.id==='walk-prompt')state.forward=0;
  }else if(['first-attack','first-guard','health-regen','real-duel'].includes(beat.segment)){
   input.yaw=yaw;state.forward=dist>1.85?.6:0;
   if(session.rival.mode!=='duel'){
    input.setGuard(['guard-attack-start','guard-prompt'].includes(beat.id),'playtest');
    if(beat.id==='attack-prompt'&&now-lastAttack>1.5){input.setAttack(true);lastAttack=now;}
    else if(now-lastAttack>.3)input.setAttack(false);
   }
  }else if(session.allows('attack',false)&&beat.segment!=='title-ending'){
   if(session.rival.mode!=='final-fight'){input.setGuard(false,'playtest');input.setAttack(false);}
   const bridge=GREENER_ROUTE.bridge;
   const stile=GREENER_ROUTE.jump;
   if(p.position.z>stile.landing.z&&r.position.z<=stile.takeoff.z){
    target=p.position.z>stile.takeoff.z+1?stile.takeoff:stile.waitPoint;dx=target.x-p.position.x;dz=target.z-p.position.z;dist=Math.hypot(dx,dz);yaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz);
    if(p.position.z<=stile.takeoff.z+1&&session.allows('jump',false))state.jump=p.grounded;
   }
   const reuse=GREENER_ROUTE.jumpReuse;
   if(reuse && p.position.z>reuse.landing.z && r.position.z<=reuse.takeoff.z){

    if(p.position.z<=reuse.takeoff.z+1&&session.allows('jump',false))state.jump=p.grounded;

==> ./docs/evidence/solo/response.js <==
// Additional input latency probe, after the encounter probe has finished.
// Uses real keyboard listeners, observes the renderer's camera and host snapshots.
globalThis.runSoloResponseProbe = async (duration = 20) => {
  const runtime = __ssRuntime, link = __ssLink, input = runtime.input;
  link.practiceRemoveDummy(); link.practiceResetPlayer();
  input.releaseInputs(); input.enabled = true; input.yaw = 0; input.pitch = 0;
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));
  const started = performance.now();
  const samples = [];
  let pending, done = false, next = started + 217, down = false, raf;
  const originalInput = link.input;
  link.input = function(packet) {
    if (pending && pending.seq === undefined && packet.forward === (down ? 1 : 0)) { pending.seq = packet.seq; pending.sendWait = performance.now() - pending.at; }
    return originalInput.call(this, packet);
  };
  const off = link.on('snapshot', snapshot => {
    const me = snapshot.players.find(p => p.id === link.playerId);
    if (pending?.seq !== undefined && me?.lastInputSeq >= pending.seq && pending.ack === undefined) pending.ack = performance.now() - pending.at;
  });
  const frame = at => {
    if (done) return;
    input.enabled = true;
    if (pending && down && pending.visible === undefined && Math.abs(runtime.camera.position.z - pending.cameraZ) > .001) pending.visible = at - pending.at;
    if (at >= next) {
      if (pending) samples.push(pending);
      down = !down;
      pending = { at: performance.now(), down, cameraZ: runtime.camera.position.z };
      document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(down ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', {code:'KeyW',key:'w',bubbles:true}));
      next = at + 733;
    }
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  };
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, duration * 1000));
  done = true; cancelAnimationFrame(raf); off(); link.input = originalInput;
  input.releaseInputs();
  globalThis.__soloResponse = { host: link.hosting, duration, samples };
  return __soloResponse;
};

// Paste into DevTools on a matching Castleward client opened with ?debug.
// Browser-only test harness: synthetic input uses the production InputController.
// Call __soloProbe.series('remote', 3) or .series('local', 3), then .results.
// Select the remote endpoint before running; keep the tab visible and viewport fixed.
(() => {
  const wait = ms => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  const percentile = (a, q) => a.length ? [...a].sort((x, y) => x - y)[Math.min(a.length - 1, Math.floor(a.length * q))] : null;
  const summary = a => ({ n: a.length, median: percentile(a, .5), p95: percentile(a, .95), max: a.length ? Math.max(...a) : null });
  const probe = { results: [], running: false, phase: 'ready' };
  globalThis.__soloProbe = probe;
  probe.series = async (host, count = 3, duration = 60) => {
    probe.running = true;
    try {
      for (let run = 1; run <= count; run++) {
        const link = __ssLink;
        link.leaveRoom();
        await wait(300);
        // Explicit hosting is only for comparison, never a user-facing routing override.
        link.hosting = host;
        link.active.startSolo('PRACTICE', 'Responsiveness', 'castleward', 'KNIGHT');
        for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !(globalThis.__ssRuntime?.playing && link.latestSnapshot?.roomState === 'PLAYING'); i++) await wait(100);
        const runtime = __ssRuntime;
        if (!runtime?.playing) throw new Error('Arena did not start');
        link.practiceSpawnDummy('FIGHTS_BACK');
        await wait(3000); // warm assets, pose buffers, shader and audio setup
        const input = runtime.input;
        const started = performance.now();
        const arrays = { frames: [], render: [], snapshot: [], correction: [], tick: [], simulation: [], clone: [], inputAck: [], actionAck: [], delivery: [] };
        const counts = {};
        const inputs = new Map();
        const pending = new Map();
        const restore = [];
        const wrap = (object, key, fn) => { const old = object[key]; object[key] = fn(old); restore.push(() => { object[key] = old; }); };
        wrap(runtime.renderer, 'render', old => function(...args) { const at = performance.now(); const v = old.apply(this, args); arrays.render.push(performance.now() - at); return v; });
        wrap(runtime, 'onSnapshot', old => function(snapshot) {
          const at = performance.now();
          const auth = snapshot.players.find(p => p.id === link.playerId);
          if (auth && this.localState) arrays.correction.push(Math.hypot(auth.position.x - this.localState.position.x, auth.position.y - this.localState.position.y, auth.position.z - this.localState.position.z));
          if (auth && inputs.has(auth.lastInputSeq)) { arrays.inputAck.push(at - inputs.get(auth.lastInputSeq)); inputs.delete(auth.lastInputSeq); }
          if (host === 'local') arrays.delivery.push(at - snapshot.serverTime * 1000);
          const v = old.call(this, snapshot); arrays.snapshot.push(performance.now() - at); return v;
        });
        wrap(link, 'input', old => function(packet) { inputs.set(packet.seq, performance.now()); return old.call(this, packet); });
        for (const [method, event] of [['attack','swordSwing'], ['guard','guardStart'], ['cast','spellGather'], ['dash','dash']]) {
          wrap(link, method, old => function(...args) { if (args[0] !== false && !pending.has(event)) pending.set(event, performance.now()); return old.apply(this, args); });
        }
        let lastTick;
        if (host === 'local') {
          wrap(link.local, 'tick', old => function(...args) { const at = performance.now(); if (lastTick !== undefined) arrays.tick.push(at-lastTick); lastTick=at; const v=old.apply(this,args); arrays.simulation.push(performance.now()-at); return v; });
          wrap(globalThis, 'structuredClone', old => function(...args) { const at=performance.now(); const v=old(...args); arrays.clone.push(performance.now()-at); return v; });
        }
        let lastSnapshot;
        const offSnapshot = link.on('snapshot', () => { const at=performance.now(); if (host==='remote' && lastSnapshot !== undefined) arrays.tick.push(at-lastSnapshot); lastSnapshot=at; });
        const offEvents = link.on('events', ({events}) => { for (const event of events) { counts[event.type] = (counts[event.type] ?? 0)+1; if ((event.playerId === link.playerId || event.attackerId === link.playerId) && pending.has(event.type)) { arrays.actionAck.push(performance.now()-pending.get(event.type)); pending.delete(event.type); } } });
        const longTasks = [];
        const observer = new PerformanceObserver(list => longTasks.push(...list.getEntries().map(e => ({at:e.startTime-started, duration:e.duration}))));
        observer.observe({type:'longtask'});
        let lastFrame;
        let finished=false, raf;
        let lastCast=-9, lastDash=-9, lastReset=-9;
        const frame = at => {
          if (finished) return;
          if (lastFrame !== undefined) arrays.frames.push(at-lastFrame);
          lastFrame=at;
          const t=(at-started)/1000;
          const me=runtime.localAuth;
          const foe=runtime.latestSnapshot?.players.find(p=>p.id!==link.playerId && p.alive);
          input.enabled=true;
          input.keys.clear();

            input.yaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz); input.pitch=0;
            if (distance>2.1) input.keys.add('KeyW');
            if (distance<1.25) input.keys.add('KeyS');
            if (t%12<3) input.keys.add('ShiftLeft');
            if (t%12>9) input.keys.add('KeyC');
            if (t%8<2) input.keys.add('KeyD');
            input.setGuard(t%6<1.4);
            input.setAttack(t%6>1.6 && t%6<4.3);
            if (t-lastCast>6) { lastCast=t; input.cast(); }
            if (t-lastDash>8) { lastDash=t; input.dash(); }
            if (t%15<.2) input.keys.add('Space');
          }
          if (!me?.alive && t-lastReset>3) { lastReset=t; link.practiceResetPlayer(); }
          probe.phase=`${host} ${run}/${count} ${t.toFixed(1)}s`;
          raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        };
        raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        await wait(duration*1000);
        finished=true; cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
        input.releaseInputs();
        observer.disconnect(); offSnapshot(); offEvents();
        for (const undo of restore.reverse()) undo();

      }
    } finally { probe.running=false; probe.phase='done'; }
    return probe.results;

(async()=>{
 const THREE=await import('three');const {WeaponView}=await import('/client/game/WeaponView.mjs');
 const {VIEW_LAYER}=await import('/client/game/viewLayers.mjs');const {SPRINT,MOVEMENT}=await import('/shared/src/movement.mjs');
 const rt=__ssRuntime,cam=rt.camera;__ssLink.setInspectionFrozen(true);
 const original=rt.weapon;rt.running=false;original.group.visible=false;let shown=null,t=100;
 const view={position:cam.position.clone(),rotation:cam.rotation.clone(),fov:cam.fov};
 const render=camera=>{const bg=rt.scene.background,clear=rt.renderer.autoClear,shadow=rt.renderer.shadowMap.autoUpdate;camera.layers.set(0);rt.renderer.render(rt.scene,camera);rt.scene.background=null;rt.renderer.autoClear=false;rt.renderer.shadowMap.autoUpdate=false;rt.renderer.clearDepth();camera.layers.set(VIEW_LAYER);rt.renderer.render(rt.scene,camera);camera.layers.set(0);rt.scene.background=bg;rt.renderer.autoClear=clear;rt.renderer.shadowMap.autoUpdate=shadow;};
 const rows=[];
 window.__gauntletPose=async name=>{
  if(shown){shown.dispose();shown.group.removeFromParent();}
  t=100;cam.position.copy(view.position);cam.rotation.copy(view.rotation);cam.fov=78;cam.updateProjectionMatrix();
  const w=new WeaponView(cam,{now:()=>t});shown=w;
  for(let n=0;!w.productionInstance&&n<100;n++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));
  if(!w.productionInstance)throw Error('Production view model did not load');
  for(let n=0;n<30;n++){t+=1/60;w.update(t,1/60);}
  const began=t;
  let age=1,speed=0,grounded=true;
  if(name==='guard'||name==='parry'){w.setGuard(true);if(name==='parry'){w.parry();age=.12;}}
  if(name.startsWith('attack-')){w.setAttack(true);age=[.4,1.08,1.8][Number(name.slice(-1))-1];}
  if(name==='sprint')speed=SPRINT.speed;
  if(name==='dash'){w.dash();age=.10;speed=MOVEMENT.dashDistance/MOVEMENT.dashDuration;grounded=false;}
  if(name==='air'){grounded=false;age=.25;}
  if(name==='landing'){for(let n=0;n<20;n++){t+=1/60;w.update(t,1/60,{grounded:false,speed:3});}age=.16;}
  if(['fireball','frostfire','gale'].includes(name)){w.cast({spell:name,gatherSec:.3});age=.20;}
  if(name==='steel'){w.clench();w.setSteel(1);age=.15;}
  if(name==='chivalry'){w.concurrent=true;w.setGuard(true);w.setAttack(true);w.cast({spell:'fireball',gatherSec:.3});age=.4;speed=SPRINT.speed;}
  const start=t;
  while(t<start+age-1e-6){const dt=Math.min(1/60,start+age-t);t+=dt;const m=w.update(t,dt,{speed,grounded,yaw:0,pitch:0});cam.rotation.set(view.rotation.x+m.camera.pitch,view.rotation.y+m.camera.yaw,m.camera.roll,'YXZ');cam.fov=m.fov;cam.updateProjectionMatrix();}
  render(cam);rt.scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  const hand=w.productionInstance.animator.bone('hand.R');const at=new THREE.Vector3();hand.localToWorld(at.set(-.0259134937,.0591134056,-.0065584332));
  if(['close','grip-above','grip-side'].includes(name)){
   const eye=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(52,cam.aspect,.001,180);const q=cam.getWorldQuaternion(new THREE.Quaternion());
   const offsets={close:[.05,.15,.32],'grip-above':[0,.32,.04],'grip-side':[.27,.02,.055]};eye.position.copy(at).add(new THREE.Vector3(...offsets[name]).applyQuaternion(q));eye.up.set(0,1,0);eye.lookAt(at);render(eye);
  }
  const row={name,time:t,sourceRevision:w.productionInstance.sourceRevision,hand:at.toArray(),viewport:[innerWidth,innerHeight],fov:cam.fov,production:w.visualKind};rows.push(row);
  window.__gauntletRows=rows;
  return row;
 };
 window.__gauntletRestore=()=>{if(shown){shown.dispose();shown.group.removeFromParent();}original.group.visible=true;cam.position.copy(view.position);cam.rotation.copy(view.rotation);cam.fov=view.fov;cam.updateProjectionMatrix();};

(async()=>{
 // Developer scenario through production input and local authority. This does not replace animation poses.
 const rt=__ssRuntime,input=rt.input,link=__ssLink,oldEnabled=input.enabled,rows=[];
 const wait=ms=>new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,ms));input.enabled=true;input.releaseInputs();
 const stream=rt.renderer.domElement.captureStream(30),chunks=[];
 const recorder=new MediaRecorder(stream,{mimeType:'video/webm;codecs=vp8',videoBitsPerSecond:1800000});
 recorder.ondataavailable=e=>{if(e.data.size)chunks.push(e.data)};
 const video=new Promise(resolve=>{recorder.onstop=()=>{const reader=new FileReader();reader.onload=()=>resolve(reader.result);reader.readAsDataURL(new Blob(chunks,{type:'video/webm'}));};});
 const began=performance.now(),sample=setInterval(()=>rows.push({at:(performance.now()-began)/1000,position:{...link.local.player.position},sprinting:link.local.player.sprinting,guarding:link.local.player.guarding,spell:link.local.player.spell,weaponState:rt.weapon.lastPoseState,framePlan:rt.weapon.lastPlan?.clip}),50);
 try {
  link.practiceSpawnDummy('GUARDING');await wait(500);recorder.start();
  input.keys.add(input.bindings.forward[0]);await wait(220);input.keys.delete(input.bindings.forward[0]);
  input.setAttack(true);await wait(2100);input.setAttack(false);await wait(500);
  input.setGuard(true);await wait(1500);input.setGuard(false);await wait(450);
  input.cast();await wait(1200);
  input.keys.add(input.bindings.forward[0]);input.keys.add(input.bindings.sprint[0]);await wait(1400);
  input.dash();await wait(700);input.keys.delete(input.bindings.sprint[0]);
  input.keys.add(input.bindings.jump[0]);await wait(200);input.keys.delete(input.bindings.jump[0]);await wait(1000);
  input.keys.delete(input.bindings.forward[0]);await wait(600);
 }finally{input.releaseInputs();input.enabled=oldEnabled;clearInterval(sample);recorder.stop();}
 const result={sourceRevision:rt.weapon.productionInstance.sourceRevision,rows,video:await video};stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());
 const el=document.createElement('script');el.id='gauntlet-live-result';el.type='application/json';el.textContent=JSON.stringify(result);document.body.append(el);
 return 'Live local authority action scenario complete';
})()

==> ./docs/release/capture-recorder.js <==
// Run only in an owned localhost /?debug preview. Records the real renderer and
// the existing post-compressor mix. It never supplies inputs or edits game state.
(() => {
  if (!['127.0.0.1', 'localhost'].includes(location.hostname)) throw new Error('Local preview only');
  let recorder, destination, timer, stream;
  window.__releaseCapture = {
    state: 'idle', data: null,
    start(seconds = 8, selector = '#game-canvas canvas') {
      if (recorder?.state === 'recording') throw new Error('Already recording');
      const canvas = document.querySelector(selector);
      const engine = window.__ssSound?.sound;
      if (!canvas || !engine?.running) throw new Error('Renderer and unlocked audio required');
      if (!(seconds > 0 && seconds <= 35)) throw new Error('Use a bounded take');
      destination = engine.ctx.createMediaStreamDestination();
      engine.compressor.connect(destination);
      stream = canvas.captureStream(30);
      for (const track of destination.stream.getAudioTracks()) stream.addTrack(track);
      const mimeType = ['video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus', 'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus']
        .find(type => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(type));
      recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType, videoBitsPerSecond: 5000000, audioBitsPerSecond: 128000 });
      const chunks = [];
      this.data = null;
      this.state = 'recording';
      this.metadata = { url: location.href, seconds, selector, width: canvas.width, height: canvas.height, mimeType,
        assets: structuredClone(window.__SPELLBLADE_ASSET_STATUS__), startedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      recorder.ondataavailable = event => { if (event.data.size) chunks.push(event.data); };
      recorder.onstop = async () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        engine.compressor.disconnect(destination);
        for (const track of stream.getTracks()) track.stop();
        const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: mimeType });
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = () => { this.data = reader.result.slice(reader.result.indexOf(';base64,') + 8); this.metadata.bytes = blob.size; this.state = 'ready'; };
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
      };
      recorder.start(500);
      timer = setTimeout(() => recorder.stop(), seconds * 1000);
      return this.metadata;
    },
    stop() { if (recorder?.state === 'recording') recorder.stop(); },
  };
})();

==> ./docs/release/devlog-draft.html <==
<p>I’m CaptainFredric, the creator, designer and voice of the Spellblade in <strong>Swords &amp; Sorcery</strong>. It’s a free browser multiplayer game about sword combat, sorcery and a knight with a flexible understanding of honor.</p>
<p>Share a room code and duel a friend, find an open match, or fight a bot. Sword contacts, Guard and parries matter. So does knowing when to answer an argument with a Fireball.</p>
<p><strong>Greener Pastures</strong> is the optional voiced tutorial. An introduction to another knight becomes a disagreement, then a duel and a chase. The Spellblade even has objections to his own stamina bar: “Why is it going down? I did not order it to.” You can skip the tutorial and enter multiplayer immediately.</p>
<p>I designed the character, combat and dialogue, and perform the Spellblade’s voice. AI has helped with implementation, networking, debugging, testing and Blender tools. Making those parts feel like one game has taken a great deal of playing, questioning and revising. Solo combat now runs locally in the browser; multiplayer keeps the server in charge of combat.</p>
<p>This is a playable pre alpha. I’m continuing to refine the character, tutorial and combat presentation. If you try it, tell me where you first felt confused, whether the controls felt responsive, or what you would like to play again.</p>
<p><a href="https://captainfredric.github.io/swords-and-sorcery/">Play Swords &amp; Sorcery</a></p>

==> ./docs/release/capture-tab-recorder.js <==
// Local release tool. Capture the selected game tab, including its real DOM HUD.
// The browser chooser must be used to select the game tab. No game inputs or
// simulation state are supplied by this tool, and no microphone is requested.
(() => {
  if (!['127.0.0.1', 'localhost'].includes(location.hostname)) throw new Error('Local preview only');
  let recorder, stream, timer;
  const button = document.createElement('button');
  button.textContent = 'RECORD THIS GAME TAB';
  button.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;right:16px;top:16px;z-index:10000;padding:14px;background:#e7c47c;color:#241e19;cursor:pointer';
  document.body.append(button);
  const capture = window.__releaseTabCapture = {
    state: 'idle', data: null,
    stop() { if (recorder?.state === 'recording') recorder.stop(); },
    dispose() { this.stop(); button.remove(); },
  };
  button.onclick = async () => {
    try {
      capture.state = 'choosing';
      stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({
        video: { width: { ideal: 1280, max: 1280 }, height: { ideal: 720, max: 720 }, frameRate: 30 },
        audio: true, preferCurrentTab: true,
        selfBrowserSurface: 'include', surfaceSwitching: 'exclude', monitorTypeSurfaces: 'exclude',
      });
      if (stream.getVideoTracks()[0].getSettings().displaySurface !== 'browser') {
        for (const track of stream.getTracks()) track.stop();
        throw new Error('Choose only the game tab');
      }
      const mimeType = ['video/mp4;codecs=avc1.42001E,mp4a.40.2', 'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus']
        .find(type => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(type));
      const chunks = [];
      capture.metadata = { url: location.href, startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        video: (({ width, height, frameRate, displaySurface }) => ({ width, height, frameRate, displaySurface }))(
          stream.getVideoTracks()[0].getSettings()), audioTracks: stream.getAudioTracks().length,
        mimeType, revision: window.__releaseCaptureRevision ?? null,
        inputs: 'Native keyboard and browser mouse controls through the ordinary game UI', hud: 'Original DOM HUD in tab capture' };
      recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType, videoBitsPerSecond: 6000000, audioBitsPerSecond: 128000 });
      recorder.ondataavailable = event => { if (event.data.size) chunks.push(event.data); };
      recorder.onstop = () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        for (const track of stream.getTracks()) track.stop();
        const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: mimeType });
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = () => {
          capture.data = reader.result.split(';base64,')[1];
          capture.metadata.bytes = blob.size;
          capture.state = 'ready';
          button.textContent = 'RECORD THIS GAME TAB';
          button.style.display = '';
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
      };
      capture.data = null;
      capture.state = 'recording';
      button.style.display = 'none';
      recorder.start(500);
      timer = setTimeout(() => capture.stop(), 60000);
    } catch (error) {
      for (const track of stream?.getTracks() ?? []) track.stop();
      capture.state = 'failed'; capture.error = error.message;
    }
  };
})();

==> ./docs/release/itch-description.html <==
<p><strong>Sword in one hand. Sorcery in the other.</strong></p>
<p>Swords &amp; Sorcery is a free first person multiplayer arena game set in Castleward. Duel with swords, catch a strike on Guard, and answer with Fireball, Frostfire or another spell. The Spellblade has strong opinions about honor. His opponents have objections.</p>
<p><a href="https://captainfredric.github.io/swords-and-sorcery/"><strong>Play the standalone browser version</strong></a></p>
<h2>Choose your first fight</h2>
<ul><li><strong>Duel a friend:</strong> create a Private Match and share its room code. No account or installation is required.</li><li><strong>Find opponents:</strong> Seek a Duel or browse Open Rooms.</li><li><strong>Learn or practice:</strong> choose Solo for the optional voiced Greener Pastures tutorial, bot duels or the Practice Yard. Solo combat runs locally in your browser.</li></ul>
<p>Equip spells and ultimates in the Armory, and choose your knight’s heraldry.</p>
<h2>Inside Castleward</h2>
<p><a href="https://img.itch.zone/aW1hZ2UvNTEyNTcyOS8zMDg4MzY0Ny5wbmc=/original/j%2FP8Bs.png"><img src="https://img.itch.zone/aW1hZ2UvNTEyNTcyOS8zMDg4MzY0Ny5wbmc=/original/j%2FP8Bs.png" alt="Actual Fireball gather facing a Guarding training dummy" style="width:48%;height:auto;" /></a> <a href="https://img.itch.zone/aW1hZ2UvNTEyNTcyOS8zMDg4MzY0OC5wbmc=/original/u1GsBv.png"><img src="https://img.itch.zone/aW1hZ2UvNTEyNTcyOS8zMDg4MzY0OC5wbmc=/original/u1GsBv.png" alt="Actual ordinary sword and Guard contact in Practice" style="width:48%;height:auto;" /></a></p>
<p>Fireball and sword contact in the Practice Yard.</p>
<p><a href="https://img.itch.zone/aW1hZ2UvNTEyNTcyOS8zMDg4MzY0OS5wbmc=/original/xIPct6.png"><img src="https://img.itch.zone/aW1hZ2UvNTEyNTcyOS8zMDg4MzY0OS5wbmc=/original/xIPct6.png" alt="Greener Pastures: Rival speaks during the voiced tutorial" style="width:100%;height:auto;" /></a></p>
<p>Greener Pastures turns learning the controls into a feud with another knight.</p>
<details><summary>Explore Castleward and the Armory</summary><p><a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CaptainFredric/swords-and-sorcery/3e4c3687d4acdc79ba8bdcab9eb3072c3c4ba516/docs/release/media/castleward-live.jpg"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CaptainFredric/swords-and-sorcery/3e4c3687d4acdc79ba8bdcab9eb3072c3c4ba516/docs/release/media/castleward-live.jpg" alt="Castleward live menu scene, distinct from playable combat" style="width:48%;height:auto;" /></a> <a href="https://img.itch.zone/aW1hZ2UvNTEyNTcyOS8zMDg4MzY1MC5wbmc=/original/sDB0nc.png"><img src="https://img.itch.zone/aW1hZ2UvNTEyNTcyOS8zMDg4MzY1MC5wbmc=/original/sDB0nc.png" alt="Current Armory spell and ultimate selection" style="width:48%;height:auto;" /></a></p><p>Castleward’s live menu scene and the Armory.</p></details>
<h2>Playing in the browser</h2>
<p>On desktop, use fullscreen and click the arena to control the camera. Default controls: WASD to move, left mouse to attack, right mouse or G to Guard, Q to cast and E to Dash. Escape opens options. How to Play and Settings cover the remaining controls and rebinding.</p>
<p>Touch controls are available; landscape is recommended. Browser compatibility is still being refined. The multiplayer server may need time to wake after inactivity; solo modes remain available once the game loads.</p>
<h2>A playable pre alpha, actively developing</h2>
<p>Created and designed by CaptainFredric, who performs the Spellblade’s voice. The character design, combat and dialogue are the creator’s work; AI assists implementation, debugging, visual development and production tools. The header is a promotional illustration. The images under Inside Castleward are actual game captures.</p>
<p>If something breaks, describe your device and browser, what you tried and what happened. A short clip or screenshot helps.</p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/CaptainFredric/swords-and-sorcery">View the source and report a problem</a></p>
<p>Buy the Spellblade a drink. He has more to say.<br><a href="https://buymeacoffee.com/captainarm1">Optional support on Buy Me a Coffee</a>. The game remains free to play.</p>

 const sun=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffe4bf,3);sun.position.set(3,5,2);scene.add(sun);
 const floor=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(12,12),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x535a62,roughness:1}));floor.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;floor.position.y=-.01;scene.add(floor);
 const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});renderer.setSize(800,500);renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
 const pane=document.createElement('section');pane.style='position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:#242a31;color:#eedcb9;display:grid;align-content:center;justify-content:center;font:18px Georgia;';
 const label=document.createElement('p');pane.append(label,renderer.domElement);document.body.append(pane);
 const remote=new RemotePlayers(scene,'local-fixture');
 const player={...source,id:'corpse-fixture',name:'Spellblade',position:{x:0,y:0,z:0},yaw:0,pitch:0,velocity:{x:0,y:0,z:0},alive:true,health:100,attackActive:false,guarding:false,crouched:false,sprinting:false,castingSpell:null,ultimateState:null,steelUntil:0,staggerUntil:0,respawnAt:0};
 remote.pushSnapshot({players:[player],serverTime:9},9000);
 for(let n=0;n<4;n++) await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);
 const results=[];
 const pose=(age,alive=false,y=0)=>{
   const time=10+age;
   const p={...player,alive,health:alive?100:0,respawnAt:alive?0:13,position:{x:alive?1:0,y,z:0}};
   remote.pushSnapshot({players:[p],serverTime:time},time*1000);remote.update(time*1000+100,1/60);
   scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);renderer.render(scene,camera);
   const shell=remote.rigs.get(p.id),animator=shell.visualInstance.animator;
   const row={age,alive,visible:shell.root.visible,position:shell.root.position.toArray(),bodies:remote.bodies().length,clip:animator.activeClip,time:animator.activeAction?.time,duration:animator.activeAction?.getClip().duration,loop:animator.activeAction?.loop,clamp:animator.activeAction?.clampWhenFinished,
     bones:['pelvis','spine','head','upper_arm.L','upper_arm.R'].map(n=>{const b=animator.bone(n);return b?{name:n,p:b.position.toArray(),q:b.quaternion.toArray()}:null;})};
   results.push(row);label.textContent=alive?'Production model: first respawn frame':`Production model: settled Death at ${age.toFixed(1)} seconds`;
   return row;
 };
 pose(0,true);pose(.01);for(let n=1;n<=110;n++) pose(Math.min(1.8,n/60));
 window.__deathFixture={remote,pose,results,renderer,pane,dispose(){remote.dispose();renderer.dispose();pane.remove();}};
 return JSON.stringify({kind:remote.rigs.get(player.id).visualKind,late:pose(2.8)});
})()

==> ./site/site.js <==
const playButton = document.querySelector('#play-button');
const playNote = document.querySelector('#play-note');
const liveUrl = String(window.SWORDS_SORCERY_PLAY_URL || '').trim();

if (playButton && liveUrl) {
  playButton.href = liveUrl;
  playButton.textContent = 'PLAY LIVE BUILD';
  playButton.classList.remove('disabled');
  playButton.removeAttribute('aria-disabled');
  playButton.rel = 'noopener';
  if (playNote) playNote.textContent = 'The live multiplayer server is online. Open the build, enter a name, and join or create a room.';
}

          <span>DASH</span><b>Dash in your movement direction</b>
          <span>ULTIMATE</span><b>Use when Prowess is full</b>
          <span>SPRINT</span><b>Tap to sprint until you let go of the stick</b>
          <span>MENU</span><b>Arena menu · practice tools</b>
        </div>
        <button class="wide-button how-settings" data-open-settings="controls">SETTINGS · CONTROLS AND KEYS</button>
        <div class="rules-copy"><p>Guard blocks sword hits. A timed Parry staggers the attacker. Damaging spells pass through Guard.</p><p>Keep holding Attack or Guard and it comes back by itself after a Parry, a stagger or a broken Guard. A Guard that comes back on its own blocks but cannot Parry; press Guard again to time one.</p><p>Sprint and Guard share stamina. Pause both to recover it. Dash moves you quickly; incoming hits can still connect. While Sheathed in Steel, Dash into an enemy to ram them, dealing light damage and heavy knockback and Balance. The Dash stops on impact.</p><p>Fighting builds Prowess for your Ultimate. Choose your spell, ward and Ultimate in the Armory.</p><p>Spells &amp; Chivalry raises Guard, then lets you Sprint, attack, Guard, Dash and cast together for 9 seconds. Release Guard to lower it. If it is broken or interrupted, hold Guard and it comes back, or raise it again; your sword and spells carry on. Tap Q to cast. Hold Q briefly to choose a prepared spell, then press 1, 2 or 3 to choose and cast immediately (Q can be let go first). On touch, drag from the spell button and release on a spell to cast. During startup, choosing only preselects.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div></div>
    </section>

/* Sheathed in Steel: armour round the health bar, never a part of it (it is no extra health). Five riveted plates frame
   the bar, a band of steel above it and below; each holds a fifth of the armour's strength (--p, 0..1, set by the HUD)
   and, as that wears, thins, dulls, greys and cracks, the right-hand plates first, until each breaks away and only a
   thin battered edge is left. Called, the plates slam on one after another; while it holds, a glint runs along them;
   struck, the frame jolts, flashes and throws sparks, and what it turned aside rises off it. */
@property --glint { syntax: '<number>'; inherits: true; initial-value: -1; }
.health-armour { position: relative; --steel: 0; }

  --p: 0; --band: calc(1px + 4.5px * var(--p));

  --rivet: radial-gradient(circle, #fbfdfe 0 0.9px, #8a96a2 1.4px, #333b43 2.1px, transparent 2.6px);
  --shine: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255, 255, 255, calc(.9 * var(--p))) 50%, transparent 70%);
  --shine-x: calc((var(--glint) * 5 - var(--i, 0)) * 100%);
  position: absolute; top: calc(-1 * var(--band) - 2px); bottom: calc(-1 * var(--band) - 2px); width: 20%;
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;

    var(--rivet) 3px 0 / 7px var(--band) no-repeat,
    var(--rivet) 3px 100% / 7px var(--band) no-repeat,
    var(--shine) var(--shine-x) 0 / 45% var(--band) no-repeat,
    var(--shine) var(--shine-x) 100% / 45% var(--band) no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(20, 24, 28, .75) 0 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 100% var(--band) no-repeat,

/* Phones and tablets: on-screen controls, landscape-first layouts for short screens, and the rotate prompt. */

:root {
  --safe-l: env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px);
  --safe-r: env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px);
  --safe-b: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
}

/* one pixel of page to scroll on touch screens (pullGuard.mjs: an app that refreshes on a pull from the top of the
   page never sees the top); the game itself stays put */
html.pull-guard { overflow-y: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }
html.pull-guard::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
html.pull-guard body { height: calc(100% + 1px); }
html.pull-guard #game-shell { position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; }

/* --- Lying sideways on a screen that stays upright (screenTurn.mjs) ------------------------------------------------
   Some apps open the game in a browser locked to portrait. The shell is then rotated a quarter turn to fill the
   portrait screen as a landscape one (the player turns the phone to meet it). --turn-w/--turn-h are the screen's
   height and width in px. Everything inside measures the shell, so the landscape layouts apply as usual. */
html[data-turn] #game-shell { position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; width: var(--turn-w); height: var(--turn-h); transform-origin: 0 0; }
html[data-turn="90"] #game-shell { transform: translateX(var(--turn-h)) rotate(90deg); }
html[data-turn="-90"] #game-shell { transform: translateY(var(--turn-w)) rotate(-90deg); }
/* the notch and the home bar are on the ends of the phone, which are now the game's left and right */
html[data-turn="90"] { --safe-l: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); --safe-r: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px); --safe-b: env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px); }
html[data-turn="-90"] { --safe-l: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px); --safe-r: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); --safe-b: env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px); }

html, body { overscroll-behavior: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
body { -webkit-user-select: none; -webkit-touch-callout: none; }
input { -webkit-user-select: text; user-select: text; }
button, input { touch-action: manipulation; }

.touch-crouch { --size: 50px; left: calc(var(--safe-l) + 90px * var(--s)); bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 196px * var(--s)); color: #e6dcc2; border-color: rgba(222, 204, 160, .62); overflow: visible; }
.touch-crouch::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -10px; border-radius: 50%; }
.touch-crouch svg { stroke-width: 2.5; }
.touch-crouch.on { color: #fff6de; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, rgba(214, 196, 150, .55), rgba(64, 58, 42, .78)); border-color: #ecd9a4; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(236, 217, 164, .3); }
.touch-crouch.crouched { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(236, 217, 164, .3), 0 0 14px rgba(236, 217, 164, .55); }

/* the ultimate: top of the right thumb's arc, above Jump; its shade drains as prowess fills, full it glows */
.touch-ultimate { --size: 50px; right: calc(var(--safe-r) + 24px * var(--s)); bottom: calc(var(--safe-b) + 222px * var(--s)); color: #e2c27a; border-color: rgba(226, 194, 122, .55); }
.touch-ultimate::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(8, 9, 7, .66); transform: translateY(calc(var(--charge, 0) * -100%)); pointer-events: none; }
.touch-ultimate.charging svg, .touch-ultimate.charging span { opacity: .55; }
.touch-ultimate.ready { border-color: #e2c27a; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(226, 194, 122, .55); }
.touch-ultimate.ready::after, .touch-ultimate.active::after { display: none; }
.touch-ultimate.active { --ring: #f0a36a; --beat: .8s; color: #f0a36a; border-color: rgba(201, 106, 58, .8); animation: touch-ultimate-active var(--beat) ease-in-out infinite; }
/* while it runs: what is left of it as a ring round the button, its edge beating; a Vortex takes on what it has been
   steered to (the blade: hot white, quick; the fire: deep orange, slow), as the desktop tile does */
.touch-ultimate.active::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; padding: 3px; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none;
  background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, var(--ring) calc(var(--left, 0) * 360deg), rgba(255, 255, 255, .08) 0);
  -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box exclude, linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
}
.touch-ultimate.active[data-emphasis="blade"] { --ring: #ffe9c6; --beat: .42s; color: #fff1d6; border-color: #e9d2aa; }
.touch-ultimate.active[data-emphasis="fire"] { --ring: #ff5a1e; --beat: 1.15s; color: #ff8a4a; border-color: #d2481a; }
@keyframes touch-ultimate-active { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 9px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 40%, transparent); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 70%, transparent); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .touch-ultimate.active { animation: none; box-shadow: 0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring) 55%, transparent); } }
